subject: Air freight quote: MUC to SGN
body:
Hi,

Could you quote the fastest air freight option from MUC to SGN, with an all-in price in EUR?

The automotive sensors will be ready on 2026-11-24. We’ll deliver them to MUC ourselves: 19 pieces, 2644 kg gross, 11.97 cbm.

The packing specification is attached.

Mira Petersen
Nordlicht Audio
